name: MIRA-v2 support-matched covariance candidate
status: EXPLORATORY POST-HOC FOLLOW-UP. Historical target results were already observed; this is not fresh preregistration or established novelty.
input_representation: Fixed log-mean scaled power18, an existing preprocessing choice, not the candidate innovation; no pooled fitting or physical dBm calibration.

variant_definitions.B: Same CNN/MLP/numerator; denominator uses all observed cell positions
variant_definitions.C: Same CNN/MLP; matched diagonal per-channel ratios, no cross-channel covariance
variant_definitions.D: Temporal MIRA CNN only, same power input/source normalization/canonical zero-fill
variant_definitions.E: A fixed features with feature MLP and classifier only

split: Existing manifest unchanged. Per fold: source train504, source validation168, familiar168, held420. Joint environment/cohort transfer, not isolated causal room effect.

normalization.fit: Source-training records only, per-band float64 population mean/std across files and time
normalization.temporal_input: Subtract source mean, divide source std on observed entries only, then exact zero-fill
normalization.spectral_input: Raw observed fixed power18 values of the individual record; hidden entries excluded

augmentation.order: Independent NumPy generator reset per seed, source permutation then per-record clean/pattern/fraction/mask-seed draws identically for A-E
augmentation.cache: Fully observed per-record features only. Actual-mask features recomputed from observed values. E shares fixed A features.

calibration.fit: One scalar temperature on clean source-validation only
calibration.objective: Stable float64 log-softmax NLL, no probability clipping

evaluation_gate: --evaluate is evaluation-only and refuses until all75 completed non-smoke checkpoints/validation outputs/receipts have been frozen and reverified together.
primary_contrast: A minus B held macro-F1 under contiguous50, pooled3folds per training-seed/mask-seed cell, then average5x5 cells; retain all per-fold/per-seed results.
secondary: C/D/E, clean/R50, accuracy/NLL/summed multiclass Brier, fixed-data participant-cluster uncertainty. >60% is an aspiration, never a stopping/tuning rule.
numerical_qualifications: Affine-spectrum result applies to fixed invertible channel transformations in ideal arithmetic on effective support; rank threshold can break numerical invariance. Neither all room changes nor full model invariance is guaranteed.
limitations: Previous target outcomes influenced research direction; independent external replication still required.
Normalized packet-index masks are synthetic, not measured acquisition outages.
No pose, thermal image, vital sign, live-user sensing or universal superiority claim.
The design may fail; known masks/MLP/covariance quotients are attributed prior art.
smoke: Separate output mode, one epoch only; cannot evaluate or contribute to75-fit freeze
